# SCI-FLT-MATCHED_TO_SCI-NOI v0.1/r0.5

Status: final targeted compatibility/request-state boundary draft; no NOI
realization or empirical-covariance equivalence is claimed available

Provisional package-title status: 'optimality_status=not_claimed'; this
boundary title and method ID are not optimality evidence.

FLT owns transformation and compatibility; NOI owns realization population and
membership meaning. Each signal bundle carries the NOI named-use status:
'not_requested', 'inapplicable', 'unavailable', 'compatible',
'requested_pending', or 'realized_child_exists'.

'K_NOI(z,y)' is evaluated before Apply from declared parent class/quantity,
WCS/grid/indexing, units/calibration, template identity, resolved generation,
local/application support and missingness, NOI authority, numerical profile,
and failure policy. Compatibility never depends on the transformed outcome.
An admitted member receives the identical resolved template, anchors, weight,
extraction, normalization, exact application support, validity rules, profile,
and failure policy. There is no per-member Learn/Resolve.

NOI validity 'V_NOI' is no broader than 'V_signal'. An unrequested,
incompatible, unavailable, failed, or absent child does not narrow signal
validity or mutate the parent. Any covariance comparison binds
'h_pre=(g_resolved,theta)' and a fixed 'P_C'; success conditioning,
censoring, pairwise deletion, and draw-dependent domains are forbidden.
